contract.zero_tensor: A successful capture may select no tensor outputs, including Store/Page-only or completion-only stages.
contract.failure: Record zero-tensor capture only after all selected views capture. A nonempty first-output failure remains distinct and keeps its exact original Status and recovery.
contract.authority: No new executor, owner, submission, retirement or resource permission; the one boolean records selection success only. Original whole-Graph wait, Source detach and typed view permissions remain authoritative.

original_fixture_checks: Both existing zero-tensor dual-Append producers feed Attention through the common bundle.
Original producer/consumer submits, bounded pending gates, device_wait=1 and host_wait=0 remain.
Original exact page values, NaN sentinel and old snapshots remain.
Actual pure SubmissionSource without selected tensor/Store/Page exports transfers only its original completion.
Count mismatch preserves the original completion; duplicate capture refuses.
First and second wrong tensor owners preserve the original partial bundle and recovery.
Default and cleared bundles still return the original empty-output FailedPrecondition.
limits: Windows single-CUDA-context checks; not multi-GPU or cross-context support.
Multiowner Store/Page combinations and complete second engine model remain separately unverified.
No native fault injection, Apple/Vulkan run or throughput/peer/memory benchmark this batch.

cleanup.retained: Original SDK objects, current consumer objects, source inputs, commands and reports
